description: Authoritative semantic identity baseline protecting foundational musical concepts, progressions, patterns, piano modules, relations, and golden reference cases from silent reassignment or semantic drift.

M01.name: Akustik, Stimmung & Frequenzarithmetik

M06.name: Stimmführung & Kontrapunkt

M08.name: Schlagzeug-Pattern, Percussion & Instrumentierung

M09.name: Genre-Konventionen & Stilistiken
